record.title: Rwanda national COVID passenger border restrictions
record.movement: Ordinary passengers; goods and returning citizens/residents exempt.
record.exceptions: Cargo, returning citizens and legal residents subject to quarantine; later local trading arrangements.
record.enforcement: Passenger bus observed crossing Rwanda to Uganda at Gatuna 7 March 2022; no Rwanda-bound passenger vehicle by17:00.
record.context: Effective at 23:59 on 21 March; phased crossing/group exceptions before national reopening.
record.uncertainty: National policy dates do not represent continuous complete shutdown at every crossing. Rubavu–Goma couriers resumed 5 November 2020. March 2022 is general reopening; pandemic overlap with GL01/GL02 must not be double-counted. The national endpoint is a policy permission; operational resumption is observed only at the specified crossing.

historical.duration_note: Formal change of permission; operational reopening and continuous effective duration not established
